title: World Changers Glasgow Scholarship
duration: Duration of the eligible postgraduate programme applied for; no separate scholarship duration is published
description: The World Changers Glasgow Scholarship is a University of Glasgow tuition fee discount of GBP 5,000 for nationals of 19 listed countries taking an eligible postgraduate programme in the September 2027 or January 2028 intake, awarded automatically rather than competitively.

title: Max Weber Fellowships — European University Institute Max Weber Programme for Postdoctoral Studies
official_source: European University Institute (EUI) — Max Weber Programme for Postdoctoral Studies
duration: 1 year, or 2 years depending on the hosting academic unit; a third year only in exceptional cases
description: The Max Weber Programme is the postdoctoral programme of the European University Institute, an intergovernmental research institute of the European Union based at Badia Fiesolana near Florence. It awards 1- and 2-year fellowships of EUR 2,500 per month to researchers within five years of completing their PhD, from any nationality. A cohort typically comprises around 65 Fellows distributed across the EUI academic units, and the annual acceptance rate is stated to be under 2%. The current call is for a 1 September 2027 start with an application deadline of 16 October 2026.

title: EASL Mobility / Research Fellowship Programme
official_source: European Association for the Study of the Liver (EASL)
program_type: Professional association research and mobility fellowship

title: Doctoral Scholarships — Studienstiftung des deutschen Volkes (German Academic Scholarship Foundation)
official_source: Studienstiftung des deutschen Volkes (German Academic Scholarship Foundation)
program_type: Foundation-funded doctoral scholarship for study and research in Germany
duration: Three years, extendable by up to six months on application, and by up to 12 months on childbirth
description: The Studienstiftung des deutschen Volkes is Germany's largest scholarship foundation and funds around 350 new doctoral students each year with a monthly stipend of EUR 1,650 for three years. Since 2024 it has replaced regional application rounds with four fixed two-week calls a year, each opening about eight months before the selection meeting. Applications are accepted only by post and must be complete. The current call runs from 1 to 14 October 2026, with the selection meeting in May 2027 and the earliest possible scholarship start on 1 July 2027.

title: HFA Research and Training Grants Programme (Heart Failure Association of the European Society of Cardiology)
official_source: Heart Failure Association of the European Society of Cardiology (HFA-ESC)
program_type: Professional association research and training grant with mandatory mobility
duration: Minimum three months; the grant is paid at EUR 2,500 per month up to a maximum of EUR 10,000
description: The Heart Failure Association of the European Society of Cardiology gives grants of up to EUR 10,000 so that young members under 40 can carry out specialised heart failure research or training in a partner laboratory or clinical centre in another ESC member country.

title: Jean Monnet Fellowships — Robert Schuman Centre for Advanced Studies, European University Institute
official_source: European University Institute (EUI) — Robert Schuman Centre for Advanced Studies
duration: One year, from 1 September 2027 for the 2027-28 academic year
description: The Robert Schuman Centre for Advanced Studies at the European University Institute offers one-year Jean Monnet Fellowships to scholars whose doctorate was completed more than five years before the fellowship start, which for the 2027-28 academic year is 1 September 2027. The Centre awards up to 20 fellowships a year to postdocs, tenure-track academics and scholars taking a sabbatical. Fellows are based at the Centre in Villa Schifanoia, are attached to one of the Centre's projects or programmes, and participate in its academic life. title: EMBO Postdoctoral Fellowships
duration: Up to two years; minimum one year; maximum combined full-time and part-time duration 36 months
description: EMBO Postdoctoral Fellowships support excellent postdoctoral researchers throughout Europe and the world for a period of up to two years. International mobility is a key requirement, and the fellowship includes a salary or stipend, a relocation allowance and support for fellows with children.
